hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *wq/config.py) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && out=$(for t in wq/test_wq_offline.py wq/test_wq_pipeline_offline.py wq/test_wq_fit_offline.py wq/test_wq_geo_offline.py; do /Users/rileysullivan/Coastal/.venv/bin/python "$t" 2>&1; done); n=$(printf '%s' "$out" | grep -c '^  FAIL '); if [ "$n" -gt 0 ]; then printf '{"decision":"block","reason":"wq/config.py was edited and %s offline check(s) now FAIL. Fix before continuing:\n%s"}' "$n" "$(printf '%s' "$out" | grep '^  FAIL ' | head -20)"; else echo '{"systemMessage":"config.py edited — all four offline suites pass."}'; fi;; esac
